meta.name: convert-documents-to-markdown
meta.description: Convert an attached Word document, presentation, spreadsheet, OpenDocument file, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF into local Markdown. Use when a message supplies a local attachment path that must be read without uploading it to an external parser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要把办公文档转成Markdown格式
copy.tagline_en: Turn office documents into local Markdown
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need office documents as Markdown

howto.what: 它会把消息中给出的本地附件(Word、演示文稿、表格、PDF、EPUB、CSV 等)在容器内转成 Markdown 文件,再只读取其中相关段落,不经外部解析服务;转换失败时会说明原因。
howto.when: 当消息附带一个本地文件路径、需要在不把文件上传到外部解析服务的前提下读取它时触发,适用于 Word、表格、PDF 等附件。

say.text: 这份 CSV 从标准输入读,按 csv 格式转换
转换后的 Markdown 很大,只读财务相关的那几节
say.note: 避免把全文塞进模型上下文

howto.what_en: Converts a local attachment path (Word, presentation, spreadsheet, PDF, EPUB, CSV, etc.) into Markdown inside the agent container, without uploading it to an external parser, and then reads only the relevant sections. Reports conversion failures clearly.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a message supplies a local attachment path that must be read without uploading the file to an external parser; covers Word, spreadsheets, PDFs, and more.

say_en.note: Writes into a temp dir under /workspace/agent/converted

say_en.text: Read this CSV from stdin and convert it as csv
say_en.note: The format must be named explicitly

say_en.text: The converted Markdown is long - read only the financial sections
say_en.note: Keeps the full output out of model context
